full_name: William Dougherty | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Arts Rieman and Baketel Fellow for Music Independent Artist
bio: William Dougherty is an American composer, sound artist, and writer whose creative work engages with elements of loss, decay, and memory through the sounds of audio recordings and audio recording technologies.
